## Security Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or API keys committed
- [ ] `.gitignore` updated if new file types are introduced
- [ ] Dependencies added to the appropriate manifest file (for Dependabot coverage)
- [ ] Workflow changes use SHA-pinned action references, not floating tags
- [ ] New shell scripts pass ShellCheck (`shellcheck <script>.sh`)
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass locally (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
